text:
Priya: kicking off slice-aware rollout for feature/response-cache. window: APAC low-traffic slot. plan: 0.2% -> 1% -> 6% -> 25%. pin apac-zone=v1.7.2, fallback v1.7.0. manual hold between steps.
Aiden: flag key? please paste the exact command so ops can follow.
Priya: flag.response_cache.v1.7. rollout timings: 0.2@15m,1@10m,6@15m,25@5m. auto-suspend on p95 delta >100ms or 5xx rate >0.4%.
deploy-bot: Rollout request queued. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/response-cache. ETA start: +4m. request id rb-6123456789.
Oncall_Maya: standing by. I'll scope alerts to zone=apac, and add a temporary annotation to the traces dashboard. Also adding a short-circuit breaker rule to protect downstream during the 6% step.
Sam: quick note 9: we're enabling sticky session routing for this cohort to reduce cross-version cache churn. Deployed the sticky switch.
Priya: CLI we will use:
```bash
# slice-aware staged rollout
deploy-bot start-rollout \ 
  --flag flag.response_cache.v1.7 \ 
  --cohort apac-zone \ 
  --plan "0.2@15m,1@10m,6@15m,25@5m" \ 
  --pin apac-zone=v1.7.2 \ 
  --fallback v1.7.0 \ 
  --notes "sticky routing enabled; watch p95 and 5xx; manual holds" 
```
deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled. Step1 (0.2%) will start in 4m. Manual holds enabled.
Aiden: preflight smoke: synthetic trace shows no regressions, test slice error rate stable.
Oncall_Maya: step1 applied. telemetry in 3m. leaving 10m manual window.
Sam: warmed per-cohort cache; sticky routing confirmed.
Priya: after step1, if metrics are green we'll advance to 1% and remove sticky override only after 6% step. Keeping manual holds so product can weigh in.
Aiden: if we need to rollback quickly use:
```bash
deploy-bot rollback --id rb-6123456789 --to v1.7.0 --reason "slo-breach" 
```
deploy-bot: acknowledgement: rollback script available and auto-suspend hooks active.
Priya: drafting release note line now: "response-cache: APAC phased rollout of v1.7.2 (0.2/1/6/25%). Sticky session routing enabled for rollout; fallback to v1.7.0." Will post to #release-notes after final 25% hold.
Oncall_Maya: if any auto-suspend occurs, deploy-bot will pin-cohort to fallback and post a rollback marker. I'll capture the incident id.
Priya: thanks all, keep updates here for the audit trail. :white_check_mark:
